'''Wiwaxia''' is an [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] [[vermin]] from the [[wikipedia:Cambrian|Cambrian]] era, found in [[tropical]] oceans or saltwater [[pool]]s. They are not butcherable or fishable, although they have the {{token|COOKABLE_LIVE|creature}} token.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] wiwaxia for their ''spines''.
